messages:
anya: Small but important a11y regression in the compact sidebar's model selector: when using arrow keys NVDA doesn't announce the active item, and sometimes focus leaves the listbox entirely. Repro: Sidebar compact mode > open model selector (listbox) > ArrowDown.
ben: ouch. Are we using aria-activedescendant or moving actual DOM focus?
anya: we were using aria-activedescendant on the listbox but recently switched to roving focus on the list items for consistency. Might have missed updating aria attributes.
rowan: console trace while reproducing: 
```
listbox: role=listbox
keydown: ArrowDown -> set aria-selected on new item
focus: listbox retains tabindex=0, item not focused
NVDA: no change announced
```
This matches NVDA not announcing aria-selected changes unless activedescendant or focus moves.
devex-gfx: design asked for roving focus so keyboard users get predictable Tab stops, but screen readers often prefer aria-activedescendant because it announces item changes without moving DOM focus. We need to pick one consistent pattern and document it.
a11y-bot: Automated checks: listbox-roles=PASS; aria-activedescendant-missing=1; roving-focus-conflict=1; focus-visible-missing=1
enya: I can reproduce on Win10 NVDA and also a bit odd on VoiceOver: VO hears the listbox name but not the item label changes.
ben: proposal: revert to aria-activedescendant for the compact variant because it's short and users expect quick announcements. Keep roving tabindex for larger lists where Tab into a row makes sense. For compact selector: role=listbox + aria-activedescendant + each option role=option and tabindex=-1.
rowan: if we switch to activedescendant we must ensure keyboard focus remains on the listbox container and that active id updates reliably during virtualization. That means stable ids on options (data-option-key).
devex-gfx: UI note: when using aria-activedescendant, we should add a visible focus ring on the listbox container and also a subtle highlight on the active option so sighted keyboard users get the context. Design token for highlight is --interactive-hover with 1.5 contrast delta.
a11y-bot: Recommendation added to RT-8122: use aria-activedescendant for compact listbox; add data-option-key for virtualization; ensure focus-visible style on container and active-option highlight.
anya: plan: (1) implement aria-activedescendant switch for compact selector + stable data keys (ben), (2) add focus-visible CSS for listbox container and active option highlight (devex-gfx), (3) add unit + integration tests simulating virtualization (rowan), (4) update docs in UX pattern library (doc owner TBD).
ben: timeline: I can spike PR for the switch today; need to check other components using the same pattern.
rowan: I'll write tests that simulate option nodes unmounting and assert aria-activedescendant points to the new DOM id or that focus remains on listbox.
devex-gfx: I'll add visual spec and snapshot for light/dark/compact and ensure active highlight meets 3:1.
a11y-bot: RT-8122 created. priority=medium. regression-tests-needed=1
anya: QA checklist to add to the ticket: 
- Windows NVDA: open compact selector, Arrow through items, NVDA announces item label on each arrow
- macOS VoiceOver: same flow and verify focus remains on listbox and VO reads active item
- Keyboard-only: Tab into selector then Enter to select, ensure Tab moves to next control afterwards
- Virtualization: with many items >1000, scroll to rehydrate window and verify active id doesn't get lost
- Mobile: ensure touch semantics unaffected
ben: will add a small console log utility in dev build so QA can capture activedescendant changes.
anya: thanks all. aiming for PR + tests by Wednesday EOD. :thumbsup:
